clips.title: The story
paras: At Rut'theran Village, Vesprystus sends travelers between Teldrassil and mainland Kalimdor. He tends the hippogryph roost at the great World Tree's base.

At Teldrassil's southern base, Vesprystus tends the Rut'theran roost. Trained hippogryphs carry travelers from the isolated elven boughs toward Darkshore and the mainland. A magical portal also links Rut'theran to Darnassus in the canopy above. Across the strait, Vesprystus works with the flight master at Auberdine to carry sentinels, emissaries, and adventurers into Kalimdor.
